{{Quote|Though as a species they rarely venture outside their caves, one Elom did make a name for himself offworld. Tanus Spijek was a spy for the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.|Spijek is mentioned in an artist's journal|<ref name="Alien Archive" />}}
'''Tanus Spijek''' was an [[Elom]] [[Gender|male]] [[spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] hired to carry messages between the [[planet]] [[Alderaan]] and the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 ABY]], Spijek was on the planet [[Tatooine]] where he spent time in the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and witnessed [[Luke Skywalker]] arrive to speak with the crime lord, and witnessed the [[Jedi]] killing Jabba's pet [[rancor]] [[Pateesa]]. The Elom was amongst those who then accompanied the Hutt to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] on the [[sail barge]] ''[[Khetanna]]'' to witness the execution of Skywalker and several of his friends. The Jedi managed to free himself and with the help of his allies killed the Hutt and destroyed the barge.

==Biography==
===Rebel spy===
The [[Elom]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Tanus Spijek was a [[spy]]-for-hire<ref name="Geektionary">''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]''</ref> from the [[planet]] [[Elom (planet)|Elom]]<ref name="Geektionary French" /> who was hired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to act as a spy and messenger<ref name="SWFC" /> for them during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Alien Archive" /> He ferried messages between [[Alderaan]], a [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] that was [[Homeworld|home]] to founding member of the Alliance [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]]—and the [[Great Temple|Alliance base]]<ref name="SWFC" /> on the [[moon]]<ref name="Geektionary" /> [[Yavin 4]],<ref name="SWFC" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Atals">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> the Empire [[Destruction of Alderaan|destroyed]] Alderaan and soon after in [[0 ABY]] the Alliance was forced to evacuated Yavin 4 following the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

===Under new employment===
{{Quote|You know who I am. ''Boba Fett''. You know what that means. All of you want to live. Who doesn't? But I promise. Fight me… some of you die. Maybe ''most'' of you. And you'd be dying… for ''him''. Doesn't seem fair, does it?|Boba Fett convinces Ephant Mon and others not to risk their lives for Bib Fortuna|<ref name="WotBH 1">[[War of the Bounty Hunters 1|''War of the Bounty Hunters'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:BobaVsFortuna2-WOTBH1.png|thumb|right|300px|Tanus Spijek refused to risk his life for Bib Fortuna.]]
Spijek then began working as an extortionist for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], but interacted with few others while at the Hutt's [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="CVD" /> In [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]] intended to deliver the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] to the palace after Solo was frozen in [[carbonite]] so that he could collect the [[bounty]] that Jabba had set on the smuggler's head. However, Solo was stolen by the [[Crimson Dawn]] crime syndicate before Fett made it to Tatooine, causing Jabba to put a bounty on Fett instead. Fett then arrived at the palace to confront the Hutt but was greeted instead by the Hutt's [[majordomo]], [[Bib Fortuna]].<ref name="WotBH 1" />

Fortuna informed Fett that Jabba was not on Tatooine as he had left to attend an [[Auction for Han Solo|auction for Solo]] being held by the Crimson Dawn. The majordomo then suggested Fett leave as Spijek and other employees of the Hutt appeared behind him, many with their weapons aimed at Fett. Instead of leaving, Fett reminded the crowd of his dangerous reputation and questioned if it was really fair that they might died fighting him only for the sake of Fortuna. Silently, the crowd lowered their weapons, and Fett passed Spijek as the bounty hunter entered the palace with Fortuna in order to see the invitation.<ref name="WotBH 1" />

===Music and celebration===
[[File:Spijek-RaiseAGlass-ROTJ.png|thumb|left|300px|Tanus Spijek (center) raised a glass to the death of Oola.]]
In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="SWGA" /> Spijek sat in one of the booths of Jabba's [[throne]] room during a<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Standard day|nightime]]<ref name="Boba Fett">{{EncyclopediaCite|Boba Fett and Other Characters of the Underworld}}</ref> performance of the [[Music|song]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> "[[Jedi Rocks]]" by the [[Max Rebo Band]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> He was seated in front of<ref name="ROTJ" /> the [[Whiphid]] [[J'Quille]]<ref name="CEUE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> in order to watch and witnessed Jabba demand that the band repeat the song. The second performance however, ended with the [[Twi'lek]] dancer [[Oola]] being dropped through a trapdoor into a pit below the throne room and devoured by Jabba's pet [[rancor]], [[Pateesa]]. As other courtiers rushed forward to watch, Spijek stayed in his booth, but raised a glass as she was eaten while others present cheered.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Immediately after the performance, [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] disguised as the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boushh]] made a commotion while entering the throne room with the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]], causing Spijek to recoil in fear as she stood in front of him to face Jabba. Organa—whose plan was in fact to try and [[Rescue of Han Solo|rescue]] Solo from Jabba—haggled with the Hutt over the [[bounty]] price for bringing him the Wookiee, activating a [[thermal detonator]] in order to scare the Hutt into increasing his offer. Spijek and many others present in the room to cowered in fear at the explosive, but much to their relief of Organa deactivated the [[grenade]] once Jabba compromised with her on the amount. Spijek later sat next to Jabba where he witnessed Organa getting caught attempting to free Solo from carbonite  .<ref name="ROTJ" />

===The downfall of Jabba===
[[File:Tanus_Spijek_Jabbas_palace.png|thumb|right|300px|Tanus Spijek (left) watched Luke Skywalker sentenced to death.]]
The court celebrated Organa's capture late into the night,<ref name="Darkside">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> and in the morning Spijek was resting in a booth alongside the [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] [[Wooof]] in the throne room. He was awoken when the [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] arrived demanding audience with Jabba. The [[Jedi]] sought to persuade Jabba to release Solo, Organa and Chewbacca. Spijek stood to watch the two speak, and witnessed Skywalker threaten the Hutt<ref name="ROTJ" /> with a [[DL-18 blaster pistol]]<ref name="USW" /> taken from the guard<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Nizuc Bek]]<ref name="SWCT">{{SWCT|set=Base Series 4|cardname=Sy Snootles & Nizuc Bek}}</ref> before being dropped into the [[rancor]] pit below the throne room.<ref name="ROTJ" />

After Jabba's pet rancor<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Pateesa]]<ref name="ALD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> ate the [[Gamorrean]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Jubnuk]],<ref name="SWCL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> who had fallen in with Skywalker, was killed by the Jedi, much to the horror of the Hutt and his court. Spijek and the crowd then watched as Skywalker and his friend [[Han Solo]] were dragged before Jabba and sentenced to death through being eaten by the [[sarlacc]] at the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. The Elom then boarded the Hutt's [[sail barge]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> ''[[Khetanna]]''<ref name="USW" /> in order to travel to the pit and witness the executions. While traveling across the [[Dune Sea]] on the barge, Spijek spoke with<ref name="ROTJ" /> the [[Ugnaught]] [[Yoxgit]].<ref name="CEUE" /> Once above the pit, Skywalker managed to free himself and board the barge<ref name="ROTJ" /> from the [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]]<ref name="USW" /> he had been transported on. Skywalker's ally [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] then killed Jabba by strangling him to death and together Skywalker and his allies destroyed the sail barge and escaped Tatooine.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Spijek was mentioned in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref> The journal noted how the spy had made a name for himself in [[the galaxy]], which was unusual for his [[species]] as they rarely left their caves.<ref name="Alien Archive" />

==Personality and traits==
Unlike most other Eloms, Tanus Spijek had no sympathy for the rebellion,<ref name="CVD" /> despite working for them,<ref name="SWFC" /> and was a vile opportunist. The extortionist had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s, calloused gray and pink skin, and a thick [[oil]]y pelt that was mottled gray, brown and white.<ref name="CVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Spijek-Maquette.png|thumb|right|150px|A maquette of Tanus Spijek]]
Tanus Spijek was portrayed by mime artist [[Graeme Hattrick]]<ref name="Actor">{{Rebelscum|subdomain=forum|url=threads/rotj-history-gerald-homes-creature-info.1069050/post-19514574|text=ROTJ History: Gerald Home's Creature Info.|author=[[Gerald Home|Home, Gerald]]|date=2014-12-19|archivedate=20220618102925}}</ref> in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character was known as "The Mole" during production and its mask was based on a maquette that depicted Spijek with lighter gray fur.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref> The character was not named in the film,<ref name="ROTJ" /> but was first identified in the current [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars video games|mobile card game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'',<ref name="SWFC" /> which initially launched in [[2013]]. Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivedate=20210505080831}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref>

The name originated from a card in the [[Jabba's Palace Limited]] set of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|Customizable Card Game]] released by [[Decipher]]<ref name="JPL">{{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Tanus Spijek}}</ref> in [[1998]].<ref name="GC">{{CollectorCite|3|It's All In The Cards}}</ref>
